title: A person overboard. A fleet of functions.
demo: Establish the rescue story. Point to the last-report marker. Explain that this is a schematic teaching model, not an operational rescue system.

title: A mini-language makes ordinary data.
demo: Open Clojure briefly and show the literal boat grid. Return to stage view. Point to the expanded vector and ask which representation the optimizer actually receives; the answer is coordinates, not boat symbols.

title: An objective configures a step.
demo: Show the first update, then play. Open One update and identify position, gradient, and base movement. Unfold HOF if time permits.

title: A bad objective, correctly optimized.
demo: Jump to the last formation. Pause. Let the audience explain the crowding before advancing.

title: A constraint is another function.
demo: Point to separation halos and the closest-pair distance.

title: Wrap the objective, keep the solver.
demo: Unfold penalize. Read the returned fn first, then map and reduce inside it.

title: A soft penalty is a tradeoff.
demo: Advance to the end and compare total, distance, penalty, and closest distance.

title: Ask the base step for a proposal.
demo: Press T to show the zero-carry first update as large numbers. Step once to reveal carried velocity. Return to Explanation before the next cue.

title: History is a value in the state.
demo: Use One update at frames 0 and 1. Add base movement to carried movement and compare the next position.

title: Return the same shape of function.
demo: Unfold the wrapper. At frame 10, use Change one thing to compare beta zero and beta 0.9. Press T for the calculation; the frame stays fixed. Choose Talk default before returning to the script. Locally, the same change can be typed into Clojure.

title: The mapping strategy is an argument.
demo: Press T to show the actual map/pmap timings and equality check. The visible fleet supplies workload context, not thread activity. Return to Explanation for the next cue.

title: Force the work before timing it.
demo: State whether this measured run was faster or slower without treating it as a benchmark claim.

title: A map can be a value function.
demo: Identify the destination, shoal, reefs, heights, and policy arrows.

title: One action is a weighted reduction.
demo: Open One update. Read one outcome row and sum the final column.

title: Bellman returns a new value function.
demo: Show the nested fn forms in Clojure, then step from V0 to V1.

title: The same iterate, a different state.
demo: Play several backups, then pause at frame 12. If time permits, select Discount gamma = 0 and watch distant value disappear without changing the operator interface. Choose Talk default before leaving the chapter.

title: We do not know the location.
demo: Point to the initial probability mass, then toggle Predicted and Posterior after the first observation.

title: Prediction transports probability mass.
demo: At the first miss, choose Predicted. Compare the shape with the prior, without claiming the person actually followed any particular path.

title: A miss is evidence, not elimination.
demo: Choose Posterior and use One update to compare predicted mass, likelihood, and posterior. Advance to the second miss.

title: Bellman now acts on beliefs.
demo: At frame 2 press Plan two searches. Compare all three first-action scores, then read the winning seen/miss decomposition. The second action is chosen from the miss posterior after another drift step. Open the notebook for every branch. Show the final sighting, then return to frame 2 before attribution.

title: A coalition gets one shared belief.
demo: Show the sector coverage map. Identify the shared-belief connection to the previous chapter.

title: Overlap changes marginal contribution.
demo: Step the first three arrivals. Point to the before, after, and gain values.

title: Average over orders, not over subsets.
demo: Compare the first and last orders. Open Clojure, then the One update notebook tab to show all six marginal gains and their means. Show that credits sum to the fleet's total expected coverage. Press S to return to stage.

title: A theorem statement is not a proof.
demo: Open Clojure, then the One update notebook tab. Expand a declaration to show its theorem identifier and empty axiom closure; the audit timestamp is below the list. Press S to return to stage. The large T calculation card does not contain these metadata.

title: Momentum has an exact recurrence.
demo: Show the worked recurrence, then briefly the projection invariant.

title: Bellman has a bound on change.
demo: The cue selects the contraction frame. Read its bound on stage; if showing the exact theorem identifier, open the One update notebook tab and expand that declaration, then return with S.

title: Try a claim without a proof.
demo: Show the rejected result. Explicitly call it recorded kernel evidence, not a kernel running in the browser.

title: Different state spaces. Familiar shapes.
demo: Let the camera pull back. Trace the connections between the three areas of the chart.

title: Functions are the architecture.
demo: Pause on the transformation signatures. Leave a beat of silence before the closing invitation.

title: Keep exploring the functions.
demo: Keep the closing card visible for questions. Do not navigate back into code while thanking the audience.
